name: Playlist up next
oneLiner: a glass player with its Up next queue: the playing video runs out, the next row lights, its thumbnail lifts out of the list and flies up into the player where it lands with a play pulse, the title swaps, the queue slides up and renumbers and a fresh progress bar starts
say: when the speaker talks about binge watching or a series ('this is part one of five', 'people watch one and the next one autoplays'): the video runs out under the setup, the next one flies into the player on 'next'
